August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 144)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network, four thrilling Adventures of Superman multi-part serial arcs starring Bud Collyer for Kellogg's Pep (1941 submarine sabotage, 1943 Civil Air Patrol U-boat hunt, 1946 concrete cartel exposé, and 1948 atomic cipher pursuit), Orson Welles exploring forensic evidence in The Black Museum, and Benny Goodman swinging with Johnny Mercer on The Camel Caravan (1939–1952):
